messages:
sana: Heads-up: after the L7 firewall tighten in eu-central this morning, several GPU nodes fail HSM decrypt during bootstrap. Kubelet shows decrypt errors and nodes never register. Anyone else seeing this?

felix: yep, ~5 fails in last 8m, all from eu-central-1a. keystore-proxy logs show `tls: handshake failure` to HSM IP 10.12.99.5:443.

dina: that IP is the regional HSM. We rolled a default-deny rule at 08:12 with a small allowlist  looks like keystore-proxy CIDR was missed.

sana: minimal log: `keystore-proxy: POST /decrypt -> 502 -> tls handshake failure` then `kubelet: node join failed: decrypt error`.

sre-oncall: impact: ~6 GPUs offline, shortfall ~12 vGPU-minutes. Recommend quick mitigation: add L7 exception for keystore-proxy -> HSM IP for eu-central.

dina: ops-bot, create CR with auto-expire 2h and attach playbook.

ops-bot: Created CR-2026-087: "eu-central L7 allow: keystore-proxy -> 10.12.99.5:443 (temp)". Approvers: @dina, @sana. Auto-expire: 2h.

felix: audit-bot shows keystore.decrypt.errors +430% during failure window, audit queue backlog spiked. Retry storm added ~1.2GB egress to SIEM.

dina: agreed long-term work: preflight allowlist check per region, staged L7 rollout (single AZ), and a deploy health-check that rolls back if node-join latency doubles. I'll own the preflight script (P0).

sana: exception applied, nodes re-joining. Two succeeded already. Monitoring for 10m.

sre-oncall: will close SEV-3 if no regressions in 15m. Please file postmortem and link CR + audit query.

dina: opened PM-2026-412 and added action items: preflight script (P0), L7 deploy checklist (P1), runbook update (P1).

sana: lesson: always include keystore/HSM endpoints in firewall allowlists when tightening L7 rules. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
